jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(F) inventory: Stowe School District, a town school district in the Lamoille South Supervisory Union (member town: Stowe). Operates PK-12.

board.post_note: Stowe SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day.

sources.note: Lamoille South SU board page (official, fetched 2026-10-22): the full Stowe board with published term expirations -- Bennett 2027, Gleason 2027, Donza (Chair) 2028, Kohn 2028, Loomis 2029. Directors are elected by Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day (Town of Stowe 2018 town report; the town's 2026 Municipal Corner confirms the March 3, 2026 district meeting and ballot). Not fetched: the certified March 2026 return and the section 423(b) size vote (resolving documents named in the research file).
